Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call.
A call with no timeout can wait as long as the other service takes.
Without a timeout, calls wait as long as the server keeps the connection open.
Missing timeouts can exhaust all worker threads (e.g., 64 threads) causing service stoppage.
Python requests library requires explicit timeout argument as it has no default.
Passing timeout=(connect_timeout, read_timeout) bounds wait times.
